title: 第18章 丘陵的死斗第19章 死去的德鲁伊
content_zh:
既然已经知道被发现已经是时间问题了。
比起躲在这里瑟瑟发抖，率先攻击才更加实在。
凯斯抽出投矛放在脚边，他本人则跳出站在石头上挥起投石索。
冬狼瞬间就发现了突然跳出的敌人。
这庞大的野兽瞬间便消失在了柯林的视线当中。
“别太紧张了，一张冬狼皮能值十几个金币呢。”说话的同时，凯斯呼啦一声将石头投出，命中猎物传来的啪嗒声甚至传到了这边。
柯林开口念咒，试图将最后一根火把点燃。
就在火焰在手间燃起的瞬间，他眼前景色瞬间变得一片模糊，隐约能瞧见身后的一阵蓝色寒雾。
摔到地上的同时，柯林瞬间便明白了事情的来龙去脉。
——冬狼冲到面前进行吐息，凯斯把我扔走了。
原本在手指间绽放的火焰变成了飞散的火星，所有努力顿时前功尽弃。
柯林将兽人短剑拔出放在脚边。
他看了眼周围，没发现什么野狼之后才再次开始点火。
凯斯的战吼和冬狼的低吼从不远处传来。
柯林施法念咒的同时，死死盯着眼前的火把。
以先前的经验来看，火焰是对付那个超级怪物的关键，这两根火把绝对能说是必不可少。
咒语的最后一个音节落下。
【火焰箭】落在地上的火把上，火焰在焦油的帮助下爆发开来，火把被瞬间点燃。
“老弟，当心！”
一道白影从旁边袭来。

在被扑倒在地的同时，柯林奋力冲着那白影举出火把。
野兽低吼的呜呜声音传到耳边，鼻尖尽是野兽口腔内传出的阵阵恶臭，火光射在那雪白的狰狞狼首上。
冬狼根本不敢上前。
它只是咔咔虚咬了几下，扰得火焰不断闪烁。
柯林一脚踢在对手的前腿上将其踹开。
周围到底有没有野狼？他脑子里闪过这样一个想法，连忙将嘴里的紫蘑菇扯下往火上晃悠，甚至都顾不得烫手。
然而那满是尖牙锐齿的狼吻里蓝光闪烁，看上去已经是蓄势待发。
说时迟，那时快。
柯林将开始冒烟的紫蘑菇扔进冬狼的嘴里，然后一把将火把也捅了进去，只听嗤嗤两声，几缕黑烟从狼吻中冒出。
紧接着，背后传来一阵巨力。
有野狼？
回头一看，半兽人那张狰狞的丑脸叫柯林安心不少。
他借着势头站起，顺带伸手捞起地上的短剑并问道：“没有其他的？”
“就这一只。”凯斯冲上前去挺矛便刺。
冬狼猛然后跳躲开矛尖。
它呜咽了两声，吐出被塞进嗓子里的火把。
紧接着又咳了两声，吐出两滩血，看上去相当难受。
content_en:
Now that it's known, it's only a matter of time before it's discovered.
Rather than hiding here and shivering, it would be more practical to attack first.
Keyes drew his throwing spear and placed it at his feet, while he jumped out and stood on the stone and swung the sling.
Winter Wolf instantly discovered the enemy that suddenly jumped out.
This huge beast disappeared from Colin's sight in an instant.
"Don't be too nervous. A winter wolf skin is worth more than a dozen gold coins." As he spoke, Case threw the stone with a huff, and the snapping sound from the hit even reached here.
Colin chanted a spell and tried to light the last torch.
The moment the flame ignited in his hand, the scenery in front of him instantly became blurry, and he could vaguely see a blue mist behind him.
As he fell to the ground, Colin immediately understood the whole story.
——The winter wolf rushed in front of me to breathe, and Case threw me away.
The flames that originally bloomed between the fingers turned into flying sparks, and all efforts were immediately wasted.
Colin pulled out the orc dagger and placed it at his feet.
He looked around and found no wild wolves before starting to light the fire again.
Case's war cry and the growl of the winter wolf came from not far away.
While Colin was casting spells and chanting spells, he stared at the torch in front of him.
Judging from previous experience, flame is the key to dealing with that super monster, and these two torches are absolutely indispensable.
The last syllable of the spell fell.
[Flame Arrow] fell on the torch on the ground, the flames exploded with the help of tar, and the torch was instantly ignited.
"Brother, be careful!"
A white shadow came from the side.
While being thrown to the ground, Colin struggled to raise the torch towards the white figure.
The roaring sound of the beast reached my ears, the tip of my nose was filled with the stench coming from the beast's mouth, and the firelight shone on the snow-white ferocious wolf head.
The winter wolf didn't dare to step forward at all.
It just clicked a few times, causing the flames to flicker.
Colin kicked his opponent's front leg and kicked him away.
Are there any wild wolves around? Such an idea flashed through his mind, and he quickly pulled the purple mushroom out of his mouth and shook it on the fire, not even caring about the burning of his hands.
However, the blue light flashed in the wolf's snout full of sharp teeth, and it looked like it was ready to go.
It's too late, but it's soon.
Colin threw the purple mushroom that was starting to smoke into the winter wolf's mouth, and then stuck the torch in. He heard two hisses, and a few wisps of black smoke came out of the wolf's kiss.
Immediately afterwards, a huge force came from behind.
Are there wild wolves?
Looking back, the orc's hideous and ugly face made Colin feel at ease.
He took advantage of the momentum to stand up, reached out to pick up the dagger on the ground, and asked, "Nothing else?"
"Just this one." Case rushed forward and thrust his spear.
The winter wolf jumped away from the spear tip.
It whimpered twice and spat out the torch that had been stuffed into its throat.
Then he coughed twice and spit out two pools of blood, looking quite uncomfortable.
